description: This file defines a class 'A2AProviderConfigManager' responsible for managing provider-specific configurations for the A2A protocol within the litellm project. It includes a method to retrieve the configuration based on a provider identifier, importing specific configuration classes as needed.

classes.name: A2AProviderConfigManager
classes.description: Manager for A2A provider configurations, offering a static method to retrieve configurations based on provider identifiers.

methods.name: Optional[BaseA2AProviderConfig] get_provider_config( custom_llm_provider: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Retrieves the provider configuration instance for the specified custom_llm_provider, returning None if not found or if input is None.
